note: DEMO CONFIG (Phase 1) - NOT the real camera setup. These four zones were marked by hand on data/demo/cafe-table.mp4 (1280x720, fixed tripod shot of one table). data/cameras.json still holds the real webcam zones and is untouched. Use with: python run.py --camera data/demo/cafe-table.mp4 --cameras data/cameras.demo.json

cameras.label: Demo clip - cafe table
cameras.notes: T1S1 and T1S2 are the two chairs someone is sitting on (expect BUSY). T1S3 and T1S4 are empty chairs in the same frame (expect FREE). The two zones that hold a person are drawn on the occupant, not the whole chair: YOLO boxes the body, so a whole-chair rectangle would only be ~30% covered and would read FREE even while someone sits there. ghost_seconds is shortened to 25 CAMPUS seconds so the abandoned-bag state is visible inside a short demo; the real config keeps 1200.
